title: AnswerResult
description: Phase 15. The structured result returned by data/src/generate_answer.py -- consumes an existing RagContext (rag_context.py, unchanged) and a Gemini-generated answer, after deterministic structural + provenance validation. See data/schema/llm_answer_generation_design.md §10/§11 for the full rationale. This schema describes generate_answer.py's OWN output -- it is NOT the schema Gemini itself is asked to produce (see GEMINI_RESPONSE_SCHEMA in generate_answer.py for that narrower, model-facing shape).

AnswerStatus.description: Exactly the four statuses justified by llm_answer_generation_design.md §6/§10 -- ANSWERED/INSUFFICIENT_CONTEXT/CONFLICTING_CONTEXT may be chosen by the model itself (within GEMINI_RESPONSE_SCHEMA's own narrower enum); VALIDATION_FAILED is assigned ONLY by generate_answer.py's own deterministic validator, never requested from or returned by the model.

SupportingChunk.description: Resolved by generate_answer.py from the RagContext it was given -- never from anything the model claims about a chunk beyond its bare chunk_id.

Grounding.description: Plain, verifiable facts about what was used -- never a manufactured numeric confidence/probability (llm_answer_generation_design.md §10).

cited_chunk_count.description: How many of those the answer actually cites (post-validation).

model_revision.description: Not every provider exposes one -- see llm_answer_generation_design.md §4/§13.
